raw_response:
This plot is small, only about one-tenth of a hectare, and I planted millet here like I do every year. I went to school small-small so I can read the bag, and the agro-dealer near our market sometimes has NPK 15-15-15 when the subsidy comes — if I get one bag I will split it between this millet plot and my other plots, so maybe half a bag reaches here. Millet does not need heavy fertilizer like maize, and I still have some goat and cattle droppings from the compound that I carry to the field before the rains. I use my own seed I kept from last harvest because improved millet seed is hard to find here and my neighbors also plant their own, so I trust it more.
